security_audit.summary: Most matches are documentation, ordinary file references, or readable Chinese text. The skill starts silent updates before consent and hides install commands. The updater passes unvalidated lockfile data to a Windows shell and inherits the full environment; no deliberate credential exfiltration was found.

remediation.issue: The skill starts silent updates before consent and hides dependency install commands from users.
remediation.suggestion: Make catalog lookup read-only by default. Show the command, source, revision, and scope before asking for separate approval to install or update.

remediation.issue: Lockfile-controlled values can reach a Windows shell or an unrestricted Git destination.
remediation.suggestion: Use a shell-free installer with separate arguments. Validate the lockfile origin, repository identity, and transport before invoking Git or the installer.

remediation.issue: Automatic updates and source fallback can replace audited instructions with an unreviewed revision.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer and skill revisions. Verify the expected artifact digest or signature, and require fresh approval for source changes or broader installation scope.

remediation.issue: Subprocesses inherit the full environment, and update state retains raw arguments and installer output.
remediation.suggestion: Pass only required environment variables to child processes. Redact URLs and output before logging, and restrict permissions on updater state and runner files.

content.user_title: Find Wind Skills for Financial Data and Research
content.value_statement: Financial requests often need separate tools for data and analysis. This skill matches requests to a local Wind catalog and identifies which dependencies are required.
actual_capabilities: Classifies requests as data lookup, analysis, or catalog exploration.
Recommends catalog entries and labels them as required workflows, required data providers, or optional additions.
Checks standard agent skill locations for required manifests and identifies missing dependencies.
Offers current-agent or global installation for missing skills and directs the agent to install after confirmation.
Maps Alice subskills to wind-alice and named investment frameworks to matching Avatar skills.
limitations: This skill does not retrieve quotes, run valuations, or place trades. It routes requests to other skills.
The catalog is a local snapshot. It may not reflect the latest availability or configuration requirements.
Recommended data providers may require credentials or additional dependencies.
The bundled workflow starts a silent background updater before lookup. The updater may replace installed files without separate approval.

use_cases.title: Find a market data provider
use_cases.description: Identify a catalog skill for Hong Kong stock prices and flag its credential requirements before requesting data.

use_cases.title: Plan a valuation workflow
use_cases.description: Identify the DCF workflow and its data provider before gathering inputs for a company valuation.

use_cases.title: Map a team skill setup
use_cases.description: Compare research, market review, and backtesting entries before approving dependencies for a shared environment.

prompt_templates.title: Browse Finance Categories
prompt_templates.prompt: Read only the local catalog. List one representative skill per category and note any setup requirements. Do not run the updater or install anything.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Data Provider
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: choose a tool for a quote request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Which catalog skill fits a Hong Kong stock quote request? List its setup requirements. Use the local catalog only, with no updates or installations.

prompt_templates.title: Identify Valuation Dependencies
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: separate the workflow from its data source.
prompt_templates.prompt: Identify the required skills for a Xiaomi DCF valuation. Separate the workflow from the data provider. Check local manifests only. Do not run commands.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Research Routes
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: distinguish an Alice subskill from a directly installable workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the catalog routes for Alice Fund Compare and an A-share post-market review. Identify required skills and configuration. Keep the review read-only.

output_examples.input: Which catalog skills are required for a Xiaomi DCF valuation?
output_examples.output: Required workflow: dcf-model. Required data provider: wind-mcp-skill, which needs a Wind API key. This recommendation does not include a valuation or market data.

output_examples.input: Which package provides the Alice Fund Compare workflow?
output_examples.output: Use wind-alice for the Fund Compare workflow. Fund Compare is an Alice subskill, not a separate package. Wind Alice requires an API key.

best_practices: Include the market, instrument, and desired output so the catalog match is specific.
Use the local catalog and manifest checks for read-only discovery. Keep the updater disabled in that workflow.
Review the source, revision, and scope before approving an installation. Prefer the narrowest scope that meets the need.
anti_patterns: Treating a recommendation as verified financial data or a completed analysis.
Installing an Alice subskill as a separate package.
Approving hidden installation commands or unattended updates on shared systems.

faq.question: Does the discovery skill need a Wind API key?
faq.answer: No. Some recommended data and analysis skills require a key or other credentials.

faq.question: Does it return market data?
faq.answer: No. It identifies a matching data skill and delegates the request if the required skill is available.

faq.question: How current is the catalog?
faq.answer: The catalog is a snapshot bundled with the skill. It is not a live directory.

faq.question: What happens if a required skill is missing?
faq.answer: The instructions ask whether to install it for the current agent or globally. Review the source and exact command before granting approval.

faq.question: Are Alice subskills installed separately?
faq.answer: No. The instructions route these requests through wind-alice and pass the subskill name to it.

faq.question: Does the default workflow perform updates?
faq.answer: Yes. It starts a background updater before catalog lookup. The updater can reinstall the skill without separate confirmation.
